/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.completion-check-', dir='.') as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / 'tasks.json'
    def run(*args):
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'tasklist.cli', '--file', str(path), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(json.dumps({'command': list(args), 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}))
        return result
    added = run('add', 'Read')
    assert added.returncode == 0
    expected = {'id': 1, 'title': 'Read', 'done': True}
    first = run('complete', '1')
    assert first.returncode == 0 and json.loads(first.stdout) == expected and first.stderr == ''
    saved = path.read_bytes()
    repeat = run('complete', '1')
    assert repeat.returncode == 0 and json.loads(repeat.stdout) == expected and repeat.stderr == ''
    assert path.read_bytes() == saved
    missing = run('complete', '9')
    assert missing.returncode == 2 and missing.stdout == '' and missing.stderr == 'unknown task\\n'
    assert path.read_bytes() == saved
print('CLI checks passed; temporary directory removed.')
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('README.md'), Path('delivery.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md'), Path('docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target.split('#')[0]).exists(), (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links across {len(pages)} pages.')
PY"
